answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the forge hash is checked against the grove checkpoint at intake, the nadir audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Each duplicate costs another 192 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
